body:
On Aug 9, 6:00 am, theunanima...@googlemail.com wrote...
> I know this might seem like a dumb question, but what exactly is
> 'Mental Health'?
> What causes it ( if anything ), and what reduces it?

The famous Unabomber said it best:

"The concept of 'mental health' in our society is defined largely by
the extent to which an individual behaves in accord with the needs of
the system and does so without showing signs of stress."
-- "Industrial Society and Its Future"
